## Time series data

- What is it? Data collected over time.
- To better understand time series data, we will look at water quality data collected from 2018-2024 at UNH's Coastal Marine Lab

## Time series data is comprised of:

1)  trend - long-term progression of dat
2)  seasonality - repeating patterns
3)  noise - random irregular fluctuations

Knowing these different componenets helps us understand patterns of the past and essential for forecasting (i.e., predicting into the future)
